description: G-REGRESSION (non-blocking, qualitative) — 13 regression queries. Each maps a query to the expected 0.5 axis activation + the connector set that MUST fire. Run via SKILL.md Adim 0.5 classifier; a regression = wrong axis fired OR a mandatory connector skipped without a logged fallback. v8.5: D-α (Regulatory MCP→openfda) + web-tier-removal (Exa→documented gap) propagated; Q11/Q12/Q13 exercise the v8.5 Extended-Tier promotion (drugddx/nlm-rxnorm, PopHIVE US-only, iuphar-gtopdb).

queries.query: Pembrolizumab 1L NSCLC PD-L1 ≥50% — global evidence + guideline placement + TR ruhsat/fiyat
queries.regression_if: oncology-layer.md not loaded OR TİTCK price path skipped OR guideline placement section absent OR society-PDF gap web-scraped

queries.query: Emicizumab inhibitörsüz Hemofili A — evidence + concomitant therapy interaction profile + TR market
queries.regression_if: DDI presented as 'interaction data' without authoritative source (substance-overlap discipline violated) OR drugddx/label-section caveat missing OR rxnorm_interactions called (D1 404) OR hematology-layer.md not loaded

queries.query: Faricimab nAMD — FDA label + EMA status + ICD-11 coding + SNOMED cross-walk
queries.regression_if: openfda called in parallel (not singly) OR ICD-11 routed to med-terminologies.icd11_search (D6 broken) OR EMA gap web-scraped OR Tier-K least-privilege caveat absent

queries.query: CAR-T DLBCL 3L — NICE/ICER cost-effectiveness + ICER threshold + budget impact
queries.regression_if: hta-layer.md not loaded OR ICER/QALY framing absent OR NICE/ICER PDF web-scraped (web tier removed)

queries.query: Tirzepatide obezite — KOL landscape (global + US + TR) + congress signal
queries.regression_if: author disambiguation skipped (single-name match) OR YÖK Akademik confused with YokTez OR medaffairs-ops-layer.md not loaded

queries.query: Bispecific T-cell engager myeloma — MoA + target + CRS safety
queries.regression_if: immunology-layer.md not loaded OR mechanism path skipped OR AdisInsight (axis 0.5.I) not fired on MoA/target signal

queries.query: Lecanemab early Alzheimer — evidence + ICD-11/condition coding + TR access outlook
queries.regression_if: neurology-layer.md not loaded OR condition coding skipped OR icd10cm used for name→code (D3; route to map_icd10_to_icd11/openfda.icd11_search)

queries.query: Risdiplam SMA — orphan evidence + ODD status + TR availability
queries.regression_if: rare-disease-layer.md not loaded OR orphan/ODD framing absent

queries.query: Lurbinectedin SCLC — pipeline snapshot + deal/licensing + catalyst
queries.regression_if: AdisInsight HyDE get_drug pattern not used OR drug-intelligence-layer.md schema not honored OR pipeline section absent

queries.query: Gastric cancer Türkiye — incidence/burden + GLOBOCAN + ICD-11
queries.regression_if: FAERS reporting counts presented as incidence OR PopHIVE presented as covering Türkiye (US-only) OR GLOBOCAN/burden web-scraped/fabricated OR epidemiology section (21) absent

queries.query: imatinib drug-drug interaction profile + RxCUI normalization for a CML regimen
queries.regression_if: rxnorm_interactions called (D1 404) OR rxnorm_related called (D2 400) OR interaction_label DailyMed-pointer presented as a computed pairwise verdict without a licensed-source cross-validation gate (G-XVAL)

PopHIVE US data presented as Türkiye data (US-only scope violated) OR PopHIVE numbers re-derived instead of relayed OR Türkiye RSV gap-note absent (global/TR burden = documented gap; TR substitutes TİTCK + EPMC AFF:Turkey + YÖK Tez)

queries.query: JAK inhibitörü hedef farmakolojisi — target/ligand profile + mechanism
queries.regression_if: mechanism claim presented without ChEMBL/EPMC cross-validation (G-XVAL) OR iuphar-gtopdb used as sole authority for a clinical claim OR OpenTargets-offline fallback not honored

pass_criteria: For each query: correct axis layer loaded AND every must_fire connector either fired OR a documented fallback (CONNECTORS.md §2) was logged. A silent skip of a must_fire connector is a regression. Clinical-impact outputs (DDI/dose/terminology) cross-validated against an authoritative source (G-XVAL). No web scraping/fabrication for documented-gap sources (web tier removed v1.4.0).
evidentia_expansion_note: Extended Tier-K (med-terminologies / nih-clinicaltables / nlm-rxnorm / iuphar-gtopdb) + drugddx are first-class as of v8.5 (live re-probe 2026-06-28; connector-registry §8). When they fire, tool-level whitelist + least-privilege + sandbox-first + clinical-cross-validation (CONNECTORS.md §5/§9, connector-registry §2.6) MUST hold; broken tools D1/D2/D3/D6 are never called. PopHIVE is US-only (relay precomputed, never re-derive; global/TR burden = documented gap).
